# Estimation with uncertainty



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

z_values <- seq(-3, 3, by = 0.01)
probabilities <- dnorm(z_values)

df <- data.frame(Z = z_values, probability = probabilities)

arrows <- tibble(
  x1 = c(2.2), 
  x2 = c(3.3),
  y1 = c(.02),
  y2 = c(0.15)
)

ggplot(df, aes(x = Z, y = probability)) +
  geom_line(
    size = 1.2,
    color = "#e8601d"
    ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = subset(df, Z >= 1.96), 
    aes(ymax = probability, ymin = 0), 
    fill = "goldenrod", 
    alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 1.96, 
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "black"
    ) +
  geom_text(
    x = 0.6, y = 0.04, 
    label = expression(italic(Z)[0.05] == 1.96), 
    color = "black", 
    size = 5,
    parse = TRUE, 
    hjust = -0.2) +
  geom_label(
    x = 2.4, y = 0.17, 
    label = expression(alpha == 0.05), 
    color = "black", 
    fill = "goldenrod",
    alpha = 0.1,
    label.size = 0,
    size = 5,
    parse = TRUE, 
    hjust = -0.2) +
  labs(
       x = expression(italic(Z)),
       y = "probability density",
       ) +
  geom_curve(
    data = arrows, 
    aes(x = x1, y = y1, xend = x2, yend = y2),
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.1, "inch"), angle = 30), 
    size = 1,
    color = "gray30", 
    curvature = 0.4
    )
```

```{.r .cell-code  code-fold="true" code-summary="Show the code"}
library(ggplot2)

t_values <- seq(-3, 3, by = 0.1)
z_values <- seq(-3, 3, by = 0.1)

dataframe <- data.frame(
  t = c(z_values, rep(t_values, 3)),
  prob = c(
    dnorm(z_values),
    dt(t_values, df = 1),
    dt(t_values, df = 5),
    dt(t_values, df = 20)
  ),
  df = factor(
    c(
      rep("standard normal", length(z_values)),
      rep("df = 1", length(t_values)),
      rep("df = 5", length(t_values)),
      rep("df = 20", length(t_values))
      ),
    levels = c(
      "df = 1", "df = 5", "df = 20", "standard normal"
      )
    ) 
  )

ggplot(
  dataframe, 
  aes(
    x = t, y = prob, 
    group = df, color = df, linewidth = df, linetype = df)
  ) +
  geom_line(
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c( rep("black", 3), "#e8601d")
    ) + 
  scale_linewidth_manual(
    values = c(1, 1, 1, 1.2)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "df = 1"="longdash", 
      "df = 5"="dashed", 
      "df = 20"="dotted",
      "standard normal"="solid" 
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(italic(t)),
    y = "probability density"
  )
```
